implementation: TypeScript/Bun orchestration of installed native updaters

backend-only.target: Resolve upstream main once, pin a full SHA, or resolve an explicit official --release tag once
backend-only.desktop: No Desktop inspection, dependency, update or version-equality requirement
sequence: Native prepare or recorded candidate reuse
Verify every declared target service image ID and gateway serving SHA
backend-only.command: bun run cli update backend-only --apply --authorization 'User requested backend update'

coordinated.target: Completed native Desktop SHA becomes the shared target; an explicit already-installed release may use a freshly native-verified existing clean artifact without a new update
sequence: Inspect verified Desktop artifact and native lifecycle footprint
Verify correlated archived receipt, build/restart completion and artifact identity
Pin the actual completed Desktop SHA
Native backend prepare/deploy for that SHA
Independently compare Desktop artifact and backend serving SHA
coordinated.runningAlignment: Known running mismatch blocks promotion; a missing running observation remains explicitly unverified while verified installed artifacts can be aligned
coordinated.runningDesktop: Use existing native updates.apply IPC through an explicit CDP endpoint; do not force-kill the app
coordinated.closedDesktop: Use the official windows.ps1 pipeline with verified roots, correlation ID, NoUi and NoGateway; release mode passes -Channel stable instead of -Branch main
coordinated.noGatewayBoundary: NoGateway does not suppress every native fleet pause/resume; inspect the native plan first
coordinated.command: bun run cli update coordinated --apply --authorization 'User requested Desktop and backend update'
coordinated.releaseTarget: --release vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH resolves the peeled official Git tag once, selects native stable delivery, and requires the correlated completed Desktop artifact to match that exact release SHA before Backend prepare/deploy
coordinated.releaseCommand: bun run update:release v0.22.0 --apply --authorization 'User requested Desktop and Backend release v0.22.0'
coordinated.releaseRunningDesktop: Stable release mode requires Desktop closed before native handoff until the existing IPC bridge can prove explicit stable target selection
coordinated.preUpdateLocalChanges: Only the configured exact tracked diff SHA256 and path set may enter native --keep-stash preservation; terminal verification independently proves the immutable stash base and diff, and all completed artifacts remain clean and release-pinned

existingReleaseFastPath.selection: Explicit --release only; current strict verified artifact SHA must equal the immutable requested release SHA
existingReleaseFastPath.verification: Fresh native PE/ASAR/renderer/freshness checks and unchanged live artifact/source/marker identity
existingReleaseFastPath.effects: Skip Desktop rebuild/restart; already-current Backend skips native writer but retains fresh serving verification
existingReleaseFastPath.receipt: Never synthesize an updater receipt for a read-only verification
existingReleaseFastPath.resume: Admitted or unknown interrupted Desktop handoffs always recover their existing receipt before any fast path
existingReleaseFastPath.resumeIntegrity: Every apply-resume from verified-existing-desktop-release rechecks native integrity against the unchanged original release target before Backend effects

performance: Read only the declared target services; avoid repeated host-wide status/file scans
Skip the optional host-wide large-file scan for target prepare/deploy jobs while retaining disk threshold checks
Reuse native recorded built/prepared candidate image IDs and hashed validation evidence
Return without rebuild or restart when the pinned version is already running and verified
Atomically publish complete immutable checkpoints before effects; resume the same SHA and native candidate rather than resolve moving main again
Keep candidate cache, receipts, images and source evidence; no automatic prune or raw deletion
accuracy: Baked Desktop commit, installed artifact commit, backend image commit and serving commit are separate observations
appVersion labels and collected systemd Result=success alone do not establish successful promotion
Require full SHA, overlay SHA256, image ID, updater hash and current lock identity
Native gateway verification uses the recorded UID/HOME/HERMES_HOME and verifies each expected profile
Park only a non-owner standby slot through native s6 without modifying the live owner's shared desired state
Observation, verification, execution authority and user acceptance stay separate
resume: Resume the original mode and run directory; immutable release-target.json retains the exact tag and peeled SHA. Do not re-resolve a moving release channel on resume or launch a second Desktop updater for an unresolved handoff.
interruptedDesktop: Recover the same persisted request and correlated native result without launching another updater; unknown or active handoffs remain unresolved
backendAttempts: Separate native backend checkpoints by reviewed updater and overlay identity while retaining the original root target SHA
sourceChangeRecovery: On an overlay conflict, keep running services intact, adapt only the existing allowed paths, verify the patch, stage it through the installed native helper and retry the same pinned target
verificationBoundary: Deterministic adapter/sequence tests and current backend readback are distinct from an executed coordinated Desktop update
rejectedNativeLaunch: A definitively rejected pre-body PowerShell binding attempt may be retried only under the same persisted request/correlation with exact script, argument, failed-result and independent no-entry proof; preserve original evidence and revalidate live scope. Unknown or admitted handoffs use receipt recovery only.
receiptPolling: Transient matching-path cache during active polling; reread original bytes every poll; complete full correlation audit after settlement and before promotion; recovery always uses a full audit
